images.actual_source_analysis: A single wooden rowing boat is moored to a pale stone riverside embankment at image left. Stone steps lead to the water. A large autumn tree fills the upper left; distant golden and green trees and a gray cloudy sky reflect in still water. The entire boat and its reflection are visible.
